subject.title: feat: generic session discussion seam with Control UI panel

question: Should OpenClaw expose a permanent generic session-discussion SDK and gateway seam, or should the initial external discussion integration remain owner-specific until its multi-provider and lifecycle contract is defined?
rationale: This PR creates a new public plugin API and Control UI capability; the repository policy requires maintainer-visible direction for new plugin API surfaces rather than allowing an implementation to set the long-term contract implicitly.

options.title: Approve a bounded generic seam
options.body: Keep the generic feature, but require agent-qualified identity, loader lifecycle ownership, and compatibility tests before merge.

options.title: Start owner-specific
options.body: Keep the initial discussion integration in its owner plugin and defer a generic SDK/gateway contract until multiple providers require it.

recommendation.title: Approve a bounded generic seam
recommendation.body: Keep the generic feature, but require agent-qualified identity, loader lifecycle ownership, and compatibility tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current implementation and its public API shape originate in this PR, so this is the closest available routing candidate for the design discussion.
